title: Singular person reference
focus: Use hän and he for people and understand both uses of te.

exercises.prompt: Which pronoun fits one person whose gender is not stated?
exercises.explanation: Hän refers to one person and does not mark that person as male or female.

optionFeedback.hän: Correct. Hän refers to one person and does not mark that person as male or female.
optionFeedback.he: “he” does not fit this subject or construction. Hän refers to one person and does not mark that person as male or female.
optionFeedback.te: “te” does not fit this subject or construction. Hän refers to one person and does not mark that person as male or female.
